afterClean.implementationPolicy: rasterize at bounded geometric scan thresholds 1, 2, 4 and 8

afterHistorical.implementationPolicy: rasterize at bounded geometric scan thresholds 1, 2, 4 and 8

beforeHistorical.implementationPolicy: attempt preview rasterization after every completed progressive scan

correctnessQualification.benchmarkInvariant: each timed operation must reproduce the reference generation count and final pixel dimensions
correctnessQualification.progressiveGenerationBounds: at least 2 and at most 4 non-final preview generations in retained tests

supportedClaims: On the bound MacBookPro18,3/macOS 27.0 build 26A5388g environment, both chunk sizes exceed the declared machine-checked 2x evidence floor for median, p90, median sampled RSS delta and maximum sampled RSS delta versus the historical per-scan implementation.
The exact clean implementation commit reproduces the historical after duration within the 0.8x to 1.2x interval for both chunk sizes.
The bounded preview policy preserves the benchmark output identity and stable generation count checked inside each timed operation.
unsupportedClaims: Cross-device, cross-OS or cross-ImageIO speedup guarantees.
A claim that progressive delivery is faster than one final decode.
A claim that every progressive JPEG or chunk schedule receives the same improvement.
Exact RSS values, energy savings, thermal savings or application-level user-visible latency improvements.
Statistical significance from paired process samples; the historical before and after captures were independent aggregates.

decisionRules.memoryReproductionPolicy: RSS sampling is required to remain at least 2x better than before; exact agreement with the first after run is not required because allocator/framework resident peaks are noisy.
decisionRules.ruleTiming: post-hoc conservative evidence qualification declared after the historical aggregates were available; not a preregistered hypothesis test

environment.swiftVersion: Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.27.1 clang-2100.3.27.1) Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0

implementation.gitBinding: source identity entries, byte counts, SHA-256 values, executable bits and covered file set were verified against the recorded commit tree

methodology.comparisonDesign: historical independent before/after aggregates plus clean exact-source after reproduction; not a paired statistical experiment
methodology.timingBoundary: session creation, all preconstructed chunk appends, preview rasterization, output checks and finish; fixture and chunk-array construction excluded

purpose: Measure the effect of replacing per-completed-scan preview rasterization with bounded geometric 1/2/4/8 scan thresholds while preserving progressive JPEG lifecycle and final output semantics.
remainingEvidence: alternating paired-process reproduction from two immutable executables if a formal percentage claim is needed
physical iOS devices and lower-performance hardware
energy, thermal and long-stream memory behavior
additional held-out progressive JPEG scan structures and network chunk schedules
